description: Dedicated Solanum Umbra wiki index. The setting preserves its own native mechanics and terminology; no Hypertext d20, 3.5, or other external-system conversion layer is applied. The first import pass covers character creation, character-sheet fields, attributes, derived statistics, origins, careers, skills, motivations, ancestry and cyborg variants, the 49% full-cyberization threshold, and data-seizure progression.

mechanicsPolicy.normalization: structure, indexing, cross-linking, provenance, and interface fields only
mechanicsPolicy.ambiguityPolicy: Record unclear or incomplete source mechanics for later native-system adjudication; do not silently replace them with rules from another game.
